tooltips.webPushEnabled: Optional channel, separate from in-app (bell) and email. Only you control this for your account. Enabling registers this browser for push; in-app notifications keep working either way.
tooltips.webPushHelp: Push is not the same as in-app notifications. Use “Check permissions” to verify browser/OS access. A setup checklist appears only if the check fails.
tooltips.webPushSendTest: Sends a real browser push to this device. Optional delay lets you minimize the window first (0 = now, max 300).

messages.webPushUnsupported: This browser does not support Web Push.
messages.webPushEnabledOk: Browser push enabled for this device.
messages.webPushPermissionsBad: Permissions are not ready. Follow the checklist below.
messages.webPushTestSent: Test push sent ({sent}). Check the OS / browser notification.
messages.webPushTestScheduled: Test push scheduled in {seconds}s — minimize the browser and wait.
messages.webPushTestFailed: Test push failed (no active subscription on this account). Enable push first.
messages.webPushTestStale: Push subscription was stale and was removed. Click the checkbox again (or retry test) to re-register this browser.
messages.webPushTestSendFailed: Test push failed (browser push service rejected delivery). Check OS/browser notification settings and retry.
messages.webPushTestInvalidDelay: Delay must be between 0 and 300 seconds.
